title: Copilot code review: API support and new default effort level
key_facts: GitHub Copilot code review can now be requested through the REST and GraphQL APIs (ways for software to talk to GitHub).
Each request can optionally set a review effort level for that review.
The change is generally available on Copilot Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise plans.
GitHub says this lets teams start reviews from their own scripts, workflows and internal tools.
Balanced is now the default review effort level for new and existing repositories and organizations; this was announced on 28 Aug 2026 and took effect on 28 Sep 2026.
Anyone who had explicitly chosen Lite kept it; the level can be set at several levels, each overriding the one above.
quote_evidence: You can now request a GitHub Copilot code review through the REST and GraphQL APIs and set the review effort level for each request.
If you explicitly selected Lite in your settings, that selection was respected.
why_it_matters_hint: Teams can start Copilot reviews automatically from their own tools, and the default review setting changed to Balanced.
event_date: 2 Oct 2026 (API support); default level change took effect 28 Sep 2026
notes: Official GitHub changelog entry, short. It does not say what Balanced does differently from other levels or whether the API costs extra.
